question: What classes of beings are claimed as attainable states by the practice, and on what basis are they grouped together?
premises: One may become a divine maiden of the gods.
One may also become a yakṣa-vidyādhara.
The connective groups these as parallel attainments.
inference: By this practice one may attain the state of a divine maiden of the gods or the state of a yakṣa-vidyādhara.
uncertainties: The gender/number agreement is compact and may be generalized beyond the literal form.
plain_english: One may become a divine maiden of the gods, and also a yakṣa-vidyādhara.
